headlines.title: Ukraine resumes strikes on Russia's oil refineries
headlines.description: Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries overnight as President Zelenskyy said he's "done" with President Trump's calls for an energy ceasefire. NBC News' Richard Engel reports on the latest in the conflict.

headlines.title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed
headlines.description: President Trump announced that the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will not be livestreamed, overriding Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s earlier claim that it would be. NBC News' Monica Alba reports the latest details from the White House.

headlines.title: Inside Michigan’s critical midterm Senate battle
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas speaks to Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, Republican Mike Rogers, and voters in Michigan.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterms
headlines.description: With less than three weeks before Election Day, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions on all things midterms.

headlines.title: Suspicious white powder sent to election offices in 3 states
headlines.description: No injuries or adverse health effects have been reported, and officials said they are working with state and federal law enforcement.

headlines.title: DOJ threatens legal action against California over alleged noncitizen voters
headlines.description: The DOJ demanded election officials review a list of possible noncitizens within 48 hours and “segregate” any mail ballots they sent in.

headlines.title: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market, as doubts grow about AI investments
headlines.description: Just a after hitting fresh all-time highs, U.S. stocks are under strain as investors worry about returns on the trillions of dollars that have been put into AI.

headlines.title: Harry and Meghan Make First Public Outing Since UK Return
headlines.description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle made their first public appearance as a couple since their surprise move back to the U.K. over the summer. While the outing looks and feels like an official royal visit that Prince William and Princess Kate carry out most weeks, Harry and Meghan are no longer working royals, and the unusual arrangement may challenge the longstanding traditions of the monarchy. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lone holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy mistrial says he has felt harassed
headlines.description: Michael P. Desronvil, the lone holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy’s high-profile murder trial, said he has been harassed since the trial ended in September.

headlines.title: Romance scammers are getting harder to catch. The consequences are costly.
headlines.description: For people looking for love online, a match with a scammer could cost them their life savings.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: FBI employees involved in Trump classified documents case sue over ‘unlawful’ firings
headlines.description: Nine former FBI employees involved in the classified documents case against President Donald Trump filed suit Thursday against FBI Director Kash Patel and Attorney General Todd Blanche, alleging their firings were “unlawful.”
